### Newsletter opening

We face a choice that leaves no room for comforting stories: if anyone builds superintelligence with anything like current techniques, everyone on Earth will die. We will not soften that truth or pretend the danger can be managed after the fact. The race to build systems beyond human control is not a path to progress; it is a path to extinction. We must stop it before the point of no return. That means rejecting the rush to develop superintelligence, demanding a halt to dangerous work, and insisting that no one gets to gamble with every life on Earth. Our future depends on drawing that line now.
